## Claims
- [computed] The complete case-insensitive literal audit of `source-30` records: `conjecture` 11 occurrences; `question` 4; `problem`, `we ask`, and `remains open` each 0. [artifact e41bdda5bdbc546ba4f92d447eb4b84c58e83833d2a7aaec6f7d620cc99d4090]
- [source-backed] The introduction says the authors conjecture that their smaller generating set for \(J_v\) is minimal, and states the resulting conditional exponential lower bound for generators of \(I_w\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 202-211]
- [source-backed] Theorem 4.8: for \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\) with \(\mathfrak S_v=s_{i^j}\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), and \(b=\min(i,j)\), \(J_v\subseteq\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) is generated by either \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\) or \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 864-876]
- [source-backed] Section 4.5 labels Conjecture 4.10: both Theorem 4.8 generating sets for \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) are minimal; it reports computer verification for \(r\le4\) and \(n-r\le5\), and gives the conditional \(\binom{2m}{m}\) lower bound when \(n=4m\), \(r=n-r=2m\), and \(i=j=m\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-955]
- [source-backed] The source further conjectures that \(M/\Lambda_+M\) requires \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) generators and suspects \(M/\Lambda_+M\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\), explicitly stating that a proof had eluded the authors. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 956-975]
- [source-backed] The subsequent example distinguishes the conjectured minimality of individual \(J_v\) generating sets from minimality after concatenation for \(I_w\), which it says fails in general. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 976-994]
- [source-backed] The introduction’s two `question` hits ask for more efficient generating sets for \(I_w\) and note that simple presentations in other root systems appear less studied. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 85-106]
- [source-backed] Question 5.1 asks whether one can find a minimal generating set for \(I_w\) in type \(A_{n-1}\), at least for specified subclasses where \(I_w\) has \(n^2\) generators. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1143-1156]
